### CVE-2006-0179
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2006-01-11 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 1411: Cisco IP Phone 7940 - Reboot (Denial of Service) (dos/hardware, 2006-01-10, verified=1)

The Cisco IP Phone 7940 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (reboot) via a large amount of TCP SYN packets (syn flood) to arbitrary ports, as demonstrated to port 80.

### CVE-2006-0354
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2006-01-22 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 1447: Cisco Aironet Wireless Access Points - Memory Exhaustion ARP (Denial of Service) (dos/hardware, 2006-01-25, verified=1)

Cisco IOS before 12.3-7-JA2 on Aironet Wireless Access Points (WAP) allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (termination of packet passing or termination of client connections) by sending the management interface a large number of spoofed ARP packets, which creates a large ARP table that exhausts memory, aka Bug ID CSCsc16644.

### CVE-2006-0515
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2006-05-09 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 27830: Cisco - WebSense Content Filtering Bypass (remote/hardware, 2006-05-08, verified=1)

Cisco PIX/ASA 7.1.x before 7.1(2) and 7.0.x before 7.0(5), PIX 6.3.x before 6.3.5(112), and FWSM 2.3.x before 2.3(4) and 3.x before 3.1(7), when used with Websense/N2H2, allows remote attackers to bypass HTTP access restrictions by splitting the GET method of an HTTP request into multiple packets, which prevents the request from being sent to Websense for inspection, aka bugs CSCsc67612, CSCsc68472, and CSCsd81734.

### CVE-2006-2369
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2006-05-15 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 1791: RealVNC 4.1.0 < 4.1.1 - VNC Null Authentication Bypass (remote/multiple, 2006-05-16, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 1794: RealVNC 4.1.0 < 4.1.1 - VNC Null Authentication Bypass (Metasploit) (remote/multiple, 2006-05-15, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 17719: RealVNC - Authentication Bypass (Metasploit) (remote/windows, 2011-08-26, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 36932: RealVNC 4.1.0/4.1.1 - Authentication Bypass (remote/windows, 2012-05-13, verified=1)
